name: Code Block
description: Filename tabs, a restrained line highlight, a diff of the same file, line numbers and a copy button that becomes a check.

props.name: files
props.description: Files with stable id, name, source lines, optional highlighted line numbers and optional diff lines. Omit for the example snippets; [] shows emptyMessage.

props.name: onFileChange
props.description: Called when a filename tab is chosen.

props.name: copyErrorMessage
props.default: "Couldn't copy. Select the code and copy it manually."
props.description: Visible failure message when clipboard access is unavailable or rejected.

props.name: file
props.description: Which file is open. The tabs update it too.

props.name: diff
props.description: Show the open file as a diff instead of the finished source.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the active tab rule, a highlighted line’s edge, and names in the code.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root section.
